description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri sapoperfunduar, ne katin e dyte te banimit.
Organizohet ne nje sallon me ambient gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet, nje korridor hyres dhe nje ballkon.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Zona eshte nder me te preferuaruat per banim cka e ben mundesi te mire per investim.
description_en: The apartment is located in a newly completed building, on the second floor of the residence. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom, an entrance hall and a balcony. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. The area is one of the most preferred for housing, which makes it a good opportunity for investment.
